facts.note: The whole map is forty-eight blocks east to west, which is as far as a party should have to walk without arriving somewhere.
Forty-eight blocks north to south as well: the site is square, so no approach is the long way round.
The hall is twelve blocks wide: wide enough that the keeper standing in its middle is felt as a figure in a room, not a figure in a doorway.
The hall stands eight blocks to its ceiling, which is what makes the yard beyond read as outside rather than as another room.
The landing is four blocks to its ceiling: low enough that a body arriving reads it as a threshold and not as a room.
